The '''Machinist Droid MC-12''' was a model of [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droid]] produced by the [[Okara Droid Company]]. A number of MC-12 droids worked in one section of the [[Okara Droid Factory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Machinist Droid MC-12 appears a type of enemy in the Bounty Hunter class mission "Chaos at the Droid Factory" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
